subject: Fix new benchmark test under the TLS (#1710)
reason: The only behavioural change is in valkey-benchmark's fcall test path under --tls: the ad-hoc FUNCTION LOAD connection now performs the TLS handshake (cliSecureConnection) instead of sending plaintext to a TLS port and asserting. Reaching it requires a TLS-enabled server (tls-port plus certificates) and tools built with BUILD_TLS=yes, none of which the fuzzer provides: tls-port is a provider-rejected config option, valkey.action.tools' private server takes no server config, and no TLS build or certificate assets exist in the harness.
